class.name: InputMapSettingsEventRows
class.brief_description: The content of the CSV settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The CSV form of [InputActions]: one [InputMapSettingsEventRow] per event, the rows of an action one after the other. See [InputMapSettingsActions] for the other formats. [InputMapSettingsServer] converts between [InputActions] and this resource when it saves and loads; games do not need this class.

members.member: The rows, one per event. The list is called [code skip-lint]actions[/code] like the list of the settings.
